'''Minoru Inaba''' (Japanese: '''稲葉実''' ''Inaba Minoru'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Inaba was born on November 8, 1951, in {{wp|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|Shizuoka}}, {{wp|Shizuoka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As an adult, he became a voice actor and led a long voice acting career since the mid-1970s. Inaba lent his voice to [[Pokémon animation]] on three occasions: first as [[Mr. Fuji]] during the [[Pokémon Origins]] miniseries, then as [[Coumarine City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Ramos]] during {{aniseries|XY}}, and then as {{an|Dr. Fuji}} in [[M22|the twenty-second movie]], replacing [[Yosuke Akimoto]]. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
